description: Extract text from an image with Tesseract. language defaults to eng. Other codes in the list are fetched when first used. Send base64 or a public URL. Private addresses are refused and the decoded file is capped at 10 MB. Returns the text and a confidence from 0 to 100. An image with no text returns an empty string.

file.description: The image. Provide url or data.

data.description: Base64 bytes or a data URI. Decoded size is capped at 10 MB.

filename.description: File name, including the extension when you have one.

mimeType.description: MIME type when you know it.

url.description: Public http or https URL. Private and local addresses are refused.

language.description: A Tesseract language code such as eng, spa, fra, deu, or jpn.

name: read_image_text
title: Read text from an image
